technical.summary: CNP shows extreme oversold conditions with minor recovery signals (RSI 9 rising, Williams %R rising) but lacks bullish confluence; price remains below all key moving averages, MACD is bearish, and three black crows pattern suggests continued weakness despite technical bounce setup.

fundamental.summary: CNP shows no fundamental momentum with zero insider activity, no institutional signal, absent government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 25 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (18/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but stale congressional data (801+ days old) and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress (inverted yield curve, VIX 335 crisis level, rising dollar, NFP event today) creates severe headwinds for utilities; earnings in 25 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI across all periods) with contrarian fear signal (18/100) and minor technical recovery (RSI 9, Williams %R rising) create a classic bounce setup near support at 24.5048.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (inverted yield curve, VIX 335, NFP event today, rising dollar), price is below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and three black crows pattern, zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 25 days make this a value trap in a utilities sector headwind.
